claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Hydrocortisone acetate at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; glucocorticoid receptor agonism in a 5-day pooled viability screen produces at most modest, non-selective growth inhibition rather than a distinct killing pattern.
